review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 每次技能授予项数依用户回答封顶6，原两版本初始1/2项与所有六项真实行为均保留。
review.singleBehavior: 每次实际使用技能按当前项数无放回等概率选六候选中对应数量并授2回合，下次项数+1封顶6；原版减红30%战阶魂回复300，强化50%/400。MISS及整招无效递增一次，控制药剂不递增，组件重放去重。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实下场/重新登场后的本次在场触发项数重建、保留或清除，与真实换宠前后增益时限的生命周期。
review.trigger: 每次在场自身使用技能时；每次使用技能后触发的效果数量增加1条

success.name: 4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});const initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=0;n<10;n++){select([0,0,0,0,0,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905,event=st.events.at(-1),count=Math.min(6,initial+n);assert.equal(event.count,count);assert.equal(event.selected.length,count);assert.equal(new Set(event.selected).size,count);assert.equal(st.usesHere,n+1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,Math.min(6,count+1));assert.equal(st.events.length,n+1);if(count===6){assert.deepEqual([...event.selected].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(const [side,key]of [[0,'必定暴击'],[1,'技能禁疗'],[0,'无视对手强化'],[0,'强化保护'],[0,'西西弗魂印减伤'],[0,'西西弗魂印战阶回复']])assert.equal(s.fighters[side].effects[key].end,n+2);}}}});

success.name: 4905真实原版六项各可被首次等概率选择，强化两项选择无重复且两源版本参数各保留
success.assertion: test('4905真实原版六项各可被首次等概率选择，强化两项选择无重复且两源版本参数各保留',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=V(2092).make({move:20177,soul:true,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,20177,20117);seen.add(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events[0].selected[0]);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(let first=0;first<6;first++){const s=V(2106).make({move:20177,soul:true});select([(first+.1)/6,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.events[0].selected[0],first);assert.notEqual(st.events[0].selected[0],st.events[0].selected[1]);assert.equal(st.sourceHash,'fabcd50e');}});

success.name: 4905真实两版使用时必暴当次攻击生效并维持两回，合法MISS和整招无效都递增一次，控制与药剂不递增
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版使用时必暴当次攻击生效并维持两回，合法MISS和整招无效都递增一次，控制与药剂不递增',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true});let crit;select([0,0],()=>turn(a,10361,20117),(e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;});assert.equal(crit,true);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].effects['必定暴击'].end,2);for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','potion']){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;select([0,0],()=>turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10361,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,mode==='control'||mode==='potion'?0:1);}}});

success.name: 4905真实两版免技能回血按来源，原已授禁疗不封血药和魂印来源回复，当前两回真实有效
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版免技能回血按来源，原已授禁疗不封血药和魂印来源回复，当前两回真实有效',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const mode of['skill','potion','soul']){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,targetHp:1000});select([.2,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗'].end,2);const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(mode==='soul'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.heal(c.a,100,'公开魂印来源回复验证','soul');}};try{turn(s,null,mode==='potion'?null:20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,mode==='potion'?1250:mode==='soul'?1100:1000);}});

success.name: 4905真实两版无视正强当前攻击不改对手原等级，强化保护真实阻清除反转吸取但不虚构免弱
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版无视正强当前攻击不改对手原等级，强化保护真实阻清除反转吸取但不虚构免弱',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true}),b=make({move:10361});a.fighters[1].stages.def=6;select([.4,.4],()=>turn(a,10361,20117));turn(b,10361,20117);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,6);const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});select([.6,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20309),(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.clearBoost(c.t),false);c.rewriteStageValues(c.t,{atk:-1},'reverse');c.steal(c.a,c.t,'公开技能来源吸强');}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);}});

success.name: 4905真实原版减红30%强化50%含当前回合，固定50不减，与同条件无魂印实际伤害对照
success.assertion: test('4905真实原版减红30%强化50%含当前回合，固定50不减，与同条件无魂印实际伤害对照',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true}),b=make({move:20177});let reduction;select([.8,0],()=>turn(a,20177,10716),(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeIncomingAttack'&&c.a.side===0)reduction=c.reduction;});turn(b,20177,10716);const fraction=id===2106?.5:.3;assert.ok(Math.abs(reduction-fraction)<1e-12);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a,'attack',1)-Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)*(1-fraction)))<=1);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,9000-sum(a,'attack',1)-50);}});

success.name: 4905真实两版战斗阶段回复300或400是魂印来源，技能禁疗不封，受普通回复倍率且当前和下一回合均执行
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版战斗阶段回复300或400是魂印来源，技能禁疗不封，受普通回复倍率且当前和下一回合均执行',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const half of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(half)timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});const amount=(id===2106?400:300)*(half?.5:1);select([.99,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+(half?125:250)+2*amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+2*(half?125:250)+2*amount);}});

success.name: 4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,loadout:[10361,10211,20177,29355,38399]}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&c.m.id===key(10361))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10211)));return out;}};try{select([0,0],()=>turn(s,10361,20117));}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events.length,1);}});

success.name: 4905全部17招有序编译和64种子基础命中暴击先制真实状态，两版2092/2106原生效果
success.assertion: test('4905全部17招有序编译和64种子基础命中暴击先制真实状态，两版2092/2106原生效果',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,1);assert.equal(st.events[0].selected.length,id===2106?2:1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,id===2106?3:2);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.name: 4905已答两版封顶后每次六次统一随机无放回、全六项状态刷新，MISS无效计次而控制药剂不计，停止用招两回自然到期
success.assertion: test('4905已答两版封顶后每次六次统一随机无放回、全六项状态刷新，MISS无效计次而控制药剂不计，停止用招两回自然到期',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000}),initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=initial;n<6;n++)turn(s,20177,20117);let draws=0;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>{draws++;return .25;};old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(s,20177,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}let st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.nextCount,6);assert.equal(draws,6);assert.equal(st.events.at(-1).selected.length,6);const before=st.usesHere;turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,before);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印减伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印战阶回复'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.nextCount,6);turn(s,20177,20117);st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,before+1);assert.equal(st.events.at(-1).count,6);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印战阶回复'].end,s.round);}}

failure.assertion: test('4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,loadout:[10361,10211,20177,29355,38399]}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&c.m.id===key(10361))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10211)));return out;}};try{select([0,0],()=>turn(s,10361,20117));}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events.length,1);}});

failure.name: 4905已答两版封顶后每次六次统一随机无放回、全六项状态刷新，MISS无效计次而控制药剂不计，停止用招两回自然到期
failure.assertion: test('4905已答两版封顶后每次六次统一随机无放回、全六项状态刷新，MISS无效计次而控制药剂不计，停止用招两回自然到期',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000}),initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=initial;n<6;n++)turn(s,20177,20117);let draws=0;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>{draws++;return .25;};old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(s,20177,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}let st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.nextCount,6);assert.equal(draws,6);assert.equal(st.events.at(-1).selected.length,6);const before=st.usesHere;turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,before);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印减伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印战阶回复'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.nextCount,6);turn(s,20177,20117);st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,before+1);assert.equal(st.events.at(-1).count,6);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印战阶回复'].end,s.round);}}

boundary.name: 4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回
boundary.assertion: test('4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});const initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=0;n<10;n++){select([0,0,0,0,0,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905,event=st.events.at(-1),count=Math.min(6,initial+n);assert.equal(event.count,count);assert.equal(event.selected.length,count);assert.equal(new Set(event.selected).size,count);assert.equal(st.usesHere,n+1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,Math.min(6,count+1));assert.equal(st.events.length,n+1);if(count===6){assert.deepEqual([...event.selected].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(const [side,key]of [[0,'必定暴击'],[1,'技能禁疗'],[0,'无视对手强化'],[0,'强化保护'],[0,'西西弗魂印减伤'],[0,'西西弗魂印战阶回复']])assert.equal(s.fighters[side].effects[key].end,n+2);}}}});

interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版无视正强当前攻击不改对手原等级，强化保护真实阻清除反转吸取但不虚构免弱',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true}),b=make({move:10361});a.fighters[1].stages.def=6;select([.4,.4],()=>turn(a,10361,20117));turn(b,10361,20117);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,6);const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});select([.6,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20309),(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.clearBoost(c.t),false);c.rewriteStageValues(c.t,{atk:-1},'reverse');c.steal(c.a,c.t,'公开技能来源吸强');}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);}});

interaction.name: 4905真实原版减红30%强化50%含当前回合，固定50不减，与同条件无魂印实际伤害对照
interaction.assertion: test('4905真实原版减红30%强化50%含当前回合，固定50不减，与同条件无魂印实际伤害对照',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true}),b=make({move:20177});let reduction;select([.8,0],()=>turn(a,20177,10716),(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeIncomingAttack'&&c.a.side===0)reduction=c.reduction;});turn(b,20177,10716);const fraction=id===2106?.5:.3;assert.ok(Math.abs(reduction-fraction)<1e-12);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a,'attack',1)-Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)*(1-fraction)))<=1);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,9000-sum(a,'attack',1)-50);}});

interaction.name: 4905真实两版战斗阶段回复300或400是魂印来源，技能禁疗不封，受普通回复倍率且当前和下一回合均执行
interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版战斗阶段回复300或400是魂印来源，技能禁疗不封，受普通回复倍率且当前和下一回合均执行',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const half of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(half)timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});const amount=(id===2106?400:300)*(half?.5:1);select([.99,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+(half?125:250)+2*amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+2*(half?125:250)+2*amount);}});

interaction.name: 4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项
interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,loadout:[10361,10211,20177,29355,38399]}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&c.m.id===key(10361))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10211)));return out;}};try{select([0,0],()=>turn(s,10361,20117));}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events.length,1);}});

interaction.name: 4905全部17招有序编译和64种子基础命中暴击先制真实状态，两版2092/2106原生效果
interaction.assertion: test('4905全部17招有序编译和64种子基础命中暴击先制真实状态，两版2092/2106原生效果',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,1);assert.equal(st.events[0].selected.length,id===2106?2:1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,id===2106?3:2);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

interaction.name: 4905已答两版封顶后每次六次统一随机无放回、全六项状态刷新，MISS无效计次而控制药剂不计，停止用招两回自然到期
interaction.assertion: test('4905已答两版封顶后每次六次统一随机无放回、全六项状态刷新，MISS无效计次而控制药剂不计，停止用招两回自然到期',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000}),initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=initial;n<6;n++)turn(s,20177,20117);let draws=0;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>{draws++;return .25;};old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(s,20177,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}let st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.nextCount,6);assert.equal(draws,6);assert.equal(st.events.at(-1).selected.length,6);const before=st.usesHere;turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,before);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印减伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印战阶回复'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.nextCount,6);turn(s,20177,20117);st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,before+1);assert.equal(st.events.at(-1).count,6);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印战阶回复'].end,s.round);}}

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 每次技能授予项数依用户回答封顶6，原两版本初始1/2项与所有六项真实行为均保留。
review.singleBehavior: 每次实际使用技能按当前项数无放回等概率选六候选中对应数量并授2回合，下次项数+1封顶6；原版减红30%战阶魂回复300，强化50%/400。MISS及整招无效递增一次，控制药剂不递增，组件重放去重。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实下场/重新登场后的本次在场触发项数重建、保留或清除，与真实换宠前后增益时限的生命周期。

success.name: 4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});const initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=0;n<10;n++){select([0,0,0,0,0,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905,event=st.events.at(-1),count=Math.min(6,initial+n);assert.equal(event.count,count);assert.equal(event.selected.length,count);assert.equal(new Set(event.selected).size,count);assert.equal(st.usesHere,n+1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,Math.min(6,count+1));assert.equal(st.events.length,n+1);if(count===6){assert.deepEqual([...event.selected].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(const [side,key]of [[0,'必定暴击'],[1,'技能禁疗'],[0,'无视对手强化'],[0,'强化保护'],[0,'西西弗魂印减伤'],[0,'西西弗魂印战阶回复']])assert.equal(s.fighters[side].effects[key].end,n+2);}}}});

success.assertion: test('4905真实原版六项各可被首次等概率选择，强化两项选择无重复且两源版本参数各保留',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=V(2092).make({move:20177,soul:true,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,20177,20117);seen.add(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events[0].selected[0]);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(let first=0;first<6;first++){const s=V(2106).make({move:20177,soul:true});select([(first+.1)/6,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.events[0].selected[0],first);assert.notEqual(st.events[0].selected[0],st.events[0].selected[1]);assert.equal(st.sourceHash,'fabcd50e');}});

failure.assertion: test('4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});const initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=0;n<10;n++){select([0,0,0,0,0,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905,event=st.events.at(-1),count=Math.min(6,initial+n);assert.equal(event.count,count);assert.equal(event.selected.length,count);assert.equal(new Set(event.selected).size,count);assert.equal(st.usesHere,n+1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,Math.min(6,count+1));assert.equal(st.events.length,n+1);if(count===6){assert.deepEqual([...event.selected].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(const [side,key]of [[0,'必定暴击'],[1,'技能禁疗'],[0,'无视对手强化'],[0,'强化保护'],[0,'西西弗魂印减伤'],[0,'西西弗魂印战阶回复']])assert.equal(s.fighters[side].effects[key].end,n+2);}}}});

boundary.name: 4905已答两版封顶后每次六次统一随机无放回、全六项状态刷新，MISS无效计次而控制药剂不计，停止用招两回自然到期
boundary.assertion: test('4905已答两版封顶后每次六次统一随机无放回、全六项状态刷新，MISS无效计次而控制药剂不计，停止用招两回自然到期',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000}),initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=initial;n<6;n++)turn(s,20177,20117);let draws=0;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>{draws++;return .25;};old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(s,20177,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}let st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.nextCount,6);assert.equal(draws,6);assert.equal(st.events.at(-1).selected.length,6);const before=st.usesHere;turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,before);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印减伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印战阶回复'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.nextCount,6);turn(s,20177,20117);st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,before+1);assert.equal(st.events.at(-1).count,6);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['西西弗魂印战阶回复'].end,s.round);}}

interaction.name: 4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回
interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版触发项数封顶6，连续十次实际用招仍无重复授六项并刷新两回',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});const initial=id===2106?2:1;for(let n=0;n<10;n++){select([0,0,0,0,0,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905,event=st.events.at(-1),count=Math.min(6,initial+n);assert.equal(event.count,count);assert.equal(event.selected.length,count);assert.equal(new Set(event.selected).size,count);assert.equal(st.usesHere,n+1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,Math.min(6,count+1));assert.equal(st.events.length,n+1);if(count===6){assert.deepEqual([...event.selected].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(const [side,key]of [[0,'必定暴击'],[1,'技能禁疗'],[0,'无视对手强化'],[0,'强化保护'],[0,'西西弗魂印减伤'],[0,'西西弗魂印战阶回复']])assert.equal(s.fighters[side].effects[key].end,n+2);}}}});

interaction.name: 4905真实原版六项各可被首次等概率选择，强化两项选择无重复且两源版本参数各保留
interaction.assertion: test('4905真实原版六项各可被首次等概率选择，强化两项选择无重复且两源版本参数各保留',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=V(2092).make({move:20177,soul:true,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,20177,20117);seen.add(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events[0].selected[0]);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(let first=0;first<6;first++){const s=V(2106).make({move:20177,soul:true});select([(first+.1)/6,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.events[0].selected[0],first);assert.notEqual(st.events[0].selected[0],st.events[0].selected[1]);assert.equal(st.sourceHash,'fabcd50e');}});

interaction.name: 4905真实两版使用时必暴当次攻击生效并维持两回，合法MISS和整招无效都递增一次，控制与药剂不递增
interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版使用时必暴当次攻击生效并维持两回，合法MISS和整招无效都递增一次，控制与药剂不递增',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true});let crit;select([0,0],()=>turn(a,10361,20117),(e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;});assert.equal(crit,true);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].effects['必定暴击'].end,2);for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','potion']){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;select([0,0],()=>turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10361,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,mode==='control'||mode==='potion'?0:1);}}});

interaction.name: 4905真实两版免技能回血按来源，原已授禁疗不封血药和魂印来源回复，当前两回真实有效

interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版无视正强当前攻击不改对手原等级，强化保护真实阻清除反转吸取但不虚构免弱',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true}),b=make({move:10361});a.fighters[1].stages.def=6;select([.4,.4],()=>turn(a,10361,20117));turn(b,10361,20117);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,6);const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});select([.6,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20309),(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.clearBoost(c.t),false);c.rewriteStageValues(c.t,{atk:-1},'reverse');c.steal(c.a,c.t,'公开技能来源吸强');}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版战斗阶段回复300或400是魂印来源，技能禁疗不封，受普通回复倍率且当前和下一回合均执行',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const half of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(half)timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});const amount=(id===2106?400:300)*(half?.5:1);select([.99,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+(half?125:250)+2*amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+2*(half?125:250)+2*amount);}});

success.assertion: test('4905/14冻伤10%成功失败与100%必施、免异真实失败，97仅冻伤才威力双倍并改变实际红伤',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const s=make({move:10211,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,10211,20309);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤']);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[false,true]);for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20150});if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,20150,20117);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤'],!immune);}const a=make({move:13011}),b=make({move:13011});a.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤']=3;const powers=[],old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)powers.push(c.power);return out;}};try{turn(a,13011,20117);turn(b,13011,20117);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(powers[0],powers[1]*2);assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b));assert.ok(a.fighters[1].hp<b.fighters[1].hp);});

success.assertion: test('4905全部17招有序编译和64种子基础命中暴击先制真实状态，两版2092/2106原生效果',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,1);assert.equal(st.events[0].selected.length,id===2106?2:1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,id===2106?3:2);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.assertion: test('4905/2000敌有正强则实际先制4且必中越过闪避，没有正强先制3并实际MISS',()=>{for(const boosted of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38397,index:0,hit:false});if(boosted)s.fighters[1].stages.def=1;timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(s,38397,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,boosted?4:3);assert.equal(sum(s)>0,boosted);}});

success.name: 4905/970双倍反转实际正2到负4及正4到负6，成功才下回合先制1，免弱失败清强而保护双拦
success.assertion: test('4905/970双倍反转实际正2到负4及正4到负6，成功才下回合先制1，免弱失败清强而保护双拦',()=>{for(const n of[2,4]){const s=make({move:38397,index:2,loadout:[38397,10361,20177,29355,38399]});s.fighters[1].stages.def=n;turn(s,38397,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,n===2?-4:-6);turn(s,10361,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);turn(s,10361,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);}for(const mode of['immune','protect']){const s=make({move:38397,index:2});s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(s,1,mode==='immune'?'免弱':'强化保护');turn(s,38397,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,mode==='immune'?0:2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984,undefined);}});

success.name: 4905/4与5自身攻击速度强化和重复双防/速命中弱化真实生效，15%弱速成功失败都覆盖
success.assertion: test('4905/4与5自身攻击速度强化和重复双防/速命中弱化真实生效，15%弱速成功失败都覆盖',()=>{for(const [move,side,levels]of[[20177,0,{atk:1}],[25283,0,{atk:2,spe:2}],[20644,1,{def:-1,spd:-1}],[30357,1,{spe:-2,acc:-2}]]){const s=make({move});turn(s,move,20309);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(levels))assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],v);}const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const s=make({move:10216,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,10216,20309);seen.add(s.fighters[1].stages.spe);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[-1,0]);});

success.name: 4905/1875已授窗口MISS仍实际用招则回复附粉，控制未用和药剂不触发技能回复；回合4结束到期
success.assertion: test('4905/1875已授窗口MISS仍实际用招则回复附粉，控制未用和药剂不触发技能回复；回合4结束到期',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','control','potion']){const s=make({move:29355,index:1,hp:1000,loadout:[29355,10361,20177,29356,38399]});turn(s,29355,20117);s.fighters[0].hp=1000;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10361,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='miss'?7000:mode==='potion'?1250:1000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='miss'?6000:0);}const a=make({move:29355,index:1,loadout:[29355,10361,20177,29356,38399]});for(let r=1;r<=4;r++)turn(a,r===1?29355:20177,20117);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].effects['西西弗用招回复附伤'],undefined);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.heal18754905.length,4);a.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(a,20177,20117);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.heal18754905.length,4);});

success.name: 4905/14冻伤10%成功失败与100%必施、免异真实失败，97仅冻伤才威力双倍并改变实际红伤
success.assertion: test('4905/14冻伤10%成功失败与100%必施、免异真实失败，97仅冻伤才威力双倍并改变实际红伤',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const s=make({move:10211,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,10211,20309);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤']);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[false,true]);for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20150});if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,20150,20117);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤'],!immune);}const a=make({move:13011}),b=make({move:13011});a.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤']=3;const powers=[],old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)powers.push(c.power);return out;}};try{turn(a,13011,20117);turn(b,13011,20117);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(powers[0],powers[1]*2);assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b));assert.ok(a.fighters[1].hp<b.fighters[1].hp);});

success.assertion: test('4905/1949复制实际正等级成功授免异1，同源刷新不叠加、异源原两次保留且新源先消费',()=>{const s=make({move:38397,index:1});s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;s.fighters[1].stages.def=1;turn(s,38397,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,3);turn(s,38397,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,3);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,38397,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ailmentImmuneSources.some(x=>x.key==='1949:38397:2f05a99a:1:0'&&x.count>0),false);});

success.name: 4905/1949自己封顶或禁强未改变等级不授免异，敌保护不阻复制且不移除敌强化
success.assertion: test('4905/1949自己封顶或禁强未改变等级不授免异，敌保护不阻复制且不移除敌强化',()=>{for(const mode of['cap','forbid','protected']){const s=make({move:38397,index:1});s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(mode==='cap')s.fighters[0].stages.def=6;if(mode==='forbid')timer(s,0,'禁强化');if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,38397,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,mode==='cap'?6:mode==='forbid'?0:2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,mode==='protected'?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,2);}});

success.name: 4905/817敌攻击MISS不授易伤而已命中零红授，1949已有次数遇191回合反弹不消费
success.assertion: test('4905/817敌攻击MISS不授易伤而已命中零红授，1949已有次数遇191回合反弹不消费',()=>{for(const miss of[false,true]){const s=make({move:29355,index:2,hit:!miss});if(miss)timer(s,1,'攻击必失');else timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,29355,10127);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['其他技能易伤'],!miss);}const a=make({move:38397,index:1,loadout:[38397,29356,10361,20177,38399]});a.fighters[1].stages.def=1;turn(a,38397,20309);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);a.moveDefinitions[key(29356)].operations=a.moveDefinitions[key(29356)].operations.filter(op=>op.index===1);const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);}};try{turn(a,29356,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']);});

success.assertion: test('4905/970双倍反转实际正2到负4及正4到负6，成功才下回合先制1，免弱失败清强而保护双拦',()=>{for(const n of[2,4]){const s=make({move:38397,index:2,loadout:[38397,10361,20177,29355,38399]});s.fighters[1].stages.def=n;turn(s,38397,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,n===2?-4:-6);turn(s,10361,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);turn(s,10361,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);}for(const mode of['immune','protect']){const s=make({move:38397,index:2});s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(s,1,mode==='immune'?'免弱':'强化保护');turn(s,38397,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,mode==='immune'?0:2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984,undefined);}});

success.name: 4905全部17招有序编译和64种子基础命中暴击先制真实状态，两版2092/2106原生效果
success.assertion: test('4905全部17招有序编译和64种子基础命中暴击先制真实状态，两版2092/2106原生效果',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,1);assert.equal(st.events[0].selected.length,id===2106?2:1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,id===2106?3:2);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

raw.description: 4回合内免疫能力下降状态；4回合内每回合使用技能恢复自身最大体力的1/3并造成等量百分比伤害，恢复体力时若自身体力低于最大体力的1/2则恢复效果翻倍；3回合内受到攻击则对手下回合受到的伤害翻倍；出手时本回合若未受到伤害则对手下1回合先制-2

success.assertion: test('4905/817受到已命中零红也授下轮红易伤双倍，真实粉固真附伤不机械翻倍',()=>{for(const zero of[false,true]){const options={move:29355,loadout:[29355,10361,20177,29356,38399]},a=make({...options,index:2}),b=make({...options,index:-1});if(zero){timer(a,0,'攻击伤害免疫');timer(b,0,'攻击伤害免疫');}turn(a,29355,10127);turn(b,29355,10127);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].effects['其他技能易伤'].start,2);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].effects['其他技能易伤'].scope4682,true);const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0&&c.m.id===key(10361)){c.hurt(c.t,100,'固定对照','fixed');c.hurt(c.t,100,'百分比对照','percent');c.hurt(c.t,100,'真实对照','true');}return out;}};try{turn(a,10361,20117);turn(b,10361,20117);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a)-2*sum(b))<=1);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),100);assert.equal(sum(a,'percent'),100);assert.equal(sum(a,'true'),100);}});

success.assertion: test('4905/942清回合成功才理论比例吸取，免粉和本体先杀仍回复3000；645严格低于三分之一威力3倍',()=>{for(const mode of['success','immune','protect','dead']){const s=make({move:38399,index:1,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='dead'?1:9000});if(mode==='protect')timer(s,1,'protect');const original=E.SOULS;if(mode==='immune')E.SOULS={...original,trait(f,k){return f.side===1&&k==='pinkImmune'?true:original.trait(f,k);}};try{turn(s,38399,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=original;}assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune'||mode==='protect'||mode==='dead'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='protect'?1000:4000);}for(const hp of[2999,3000,3001]){const s=make({move:38399,index:2,hp});let power;const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)power=c.power;return out;}};try{turn(s,38399,20117);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(power,hp<3000?480:160);}});

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 附加自身最大体力值20%的百分比伤害，连续使用每次增加10%，最高40%

success.name: 4905/1080连续仅加先制1与1155实际20/30/40/40百分比，保1不截断完整伤害，中断技能后恢复20及先制0
success.assertion: test('4905/1080连续仅加先制1与1155实际20/30/40/40百分比，保1不截断完整伤害，中断技能后恢复20及先制0',()=>{const s=make({move:38399,loadout:[38399,20177,10361,29355,38398]});s.moveDefinitions[key(38399)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(38399)].operations.filter(op=>[0,3].includes(op.index));timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});for(let n=1;n<=4;n++){turn(s,38399,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n>1?1:0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),[1800,2700,3600,3600][n-1]);}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);turn(s,20177,20117);turn(s,38399,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),1800);});
